notes: Claude Haiku 5.5 System Card (144 pages), extracted with pdftotext -layout. Records every numeric cell of Table 8.1.A (p. 111), including the second (xhigh) FrontierCode values, and exact values printed in Section 8 prose. Effort is recorded only where the caption or section text states it; competitor table values are `unknown` unless a section says all models ran at max. Haiku 4.5 rows carry effort null. Key fact for OSWorld: the 72.4% headline is the partial-credit score on the 82-task offline subset; the strict pass rate (every checkpoint) is 37.1%. Medium-effort (default) values exist for GDPval-AA (1277), AA-Briefcase (1372), HealthBench, HealthBench Professional, and PhysicianBench. Groups separate Table 8.1.A from prose readings where they could differ.
